title: UploadCollection
description: Fiori upload collection: file list with thumbnails, progress and Complete/Error/Ready/Uploading states, retry/terminate/delete, drag & drop overlay (ui5-upload-collection). Upload transport is up to the caller.

usage.summary: Manage prepared or uploaded files with per-file status and lifecycle actions.
useWhen: Let users review a collection of attachments and remove, retry or terminate individual uploads.
Use UploadCollectionItem uploadState and progress for per-file feedback; handle onDropFiles and upload transport in the application.
Keep filenames, thumbnails and descriptive metadata together for files before or after upload.

avoidWhen.when: Select local files for a form without showing or managing an attachment collection.
Inspect images or videos through thumbnails without upload lifecycle actions.
